question: Did a complete bounded SSE data event survive as contiguous bytes anywhere in the physical image after the ChatGPT tab closed?

method.scanner: The unchanged bounded sse_event_records.scan grammar read one synthetic identity row across the fully verified physical stream in host RAM.
method.synthetic_adapter_positive_control: A separate synthetic test accepted a complete JSON data event. It is not a real-capture positive control.

interpretation: Thirty-three data-prefix bytes are not thirty-three events. This physical scan recovered no complete framed JSON SSE event in the close-tab image. It cannot rule out an event split across nonadjacent physical pages or another response representation. The one exact full-answer physical hit was later classified as an investigator page-observation copy in EDGE_CLOSE_OBSERVER_COPY_20261001.json, not an independent Edge event.
